objective: Extract reusable ONIA/Higgsfield production principles from Sergio's Instagram Reel and WhatsApp video references.
main_verdict: This batch is useful for ONIA because it teaches a production system: decompose references, build consistent characters, separate tools by job, and control costs. The influencer/fashion framing is not the ONIA angle; the ONIA angle is repeatable business video production for demos, ads, workflows and client-safe UGC.

useful_for_ONIA.use: Turn any reference into scene cards, camera notes, movement, mood and prompt blocks without copying it.
useful_for_ONIA.application: Higgsfield prompts, Video Lab briefs, client campaign planning.

useful_for_ONIA.use: Assign LLMs to planning, image models to character stills, video models to motion, voice tools to narration and Hermes to approvals/memory.
useful_for_ONIA.application: Internal SOP, pricing, margin protection and onboarding sellers.

useful_for_ONIA.use: Create approved character packs with front/side/back/smile references, then test before delivery.
useful_for_ONIA.application: Client avatars, Sergio content, AI UGC and concept videos.

useful_for_ONIA.use: Avoid paying many tools without a clear role; prefer aggregators only if they reduce operational cost.
useful_for_ONIA.application: Service pricing, package margins, production planning.

useful_for_ONIA.use: Show tool UI, reference board, before/after output or troubleshooting tip.
useful_for_ONIA.application: ONIA authority Reels and client trust videos.

not_useful_or_discard.reason: It can distract from ONIA's B2B automation, SaaS and client marketing positioning.
not_useful_or_discard.replacement: Use dentists, restaurants, ecommerce, real estate, gyms, SaaS demos and local business workflows.

not_useful_or_discard.reason: Legal and ethical risk; it can sound like cloning creators.
Not client-safe and not aligned with ONIA's professional offer.
not_useful_or_discard.replacement: Discuss approved brand constraints and safety review.
Document each tool's job and allow replacement by equivalent platforms.

not_useful_or_discard.reason: ONIA must not sell results it cannot prove.
not_useful_or_discard.replacement: Show process proof, not fake results.

ONIA_video_formats_to_create.cta: Pide el flujo para tu rubro.

ONIA_video_formats_to_create.hook: No necesitas copiar influencers para vender con IA; necesitas un sistema aprobado.

Higgsfield_prompt_template.base: Create a vertical 9:16 educational AI video for ONIA. Show a founder/operator turning a public reference into an original business video: reference analysis cards, scene decomposition, character reference board, prompt rewrite, generation preview and final client-safe output. Spanish captions, fast but readable cuts, clean UI overlays, practical B2B tone.
Higgsfield_prompt_template.negative: No copied creator likeness, no copied voice, no recognizable third-party edit, no unapproved logos, no fake results, no body/fashion influencer framing, no censorship-bypass language, no unreadable UI text.

production_rules: Always state that references are inspiration, not source material to copy.
Use a human approval step before generating client-facing videos.
Keep generated face/voice content out of publishing until Sergio approves.
Document tool costs per video before setting prices.
If a tool changes availability, keep the workflow and replace the vendor.
